releaseNotes: Arabic index writeback repair. The one-file diagnostic proved the exact original PDF can read ‘عبد الرحيم’ with Tesseract on Android. v0.9.8 now makes Arabic Rescue use the same 2000px Tesseract-quality path before merging OCR text into the existing Smart Search row. A new arabic_repair_v3 checkpoint generation retries files previously attempted at lower resolution, up to 48 candidates per Arabic search, and future scanned PDF/image OCR also uses the 2000px quality floor. The completed main index is preserved; no rebuild or clear is performed.
